import sys

def min_quadcopter_path(x1, y1, x2, y2):
    # Calculate the Manhattan distances
    dx = abs(x1 - x2)
    dy = abs(y1 - y2)
    
    # The minimum path length is the sum of the distances plus 4 (to form a rectangle)
    return 2 * (dx + dy) + 4

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    x1 = int(data[0])
    y1 = int(data[1])
    x2 = int(data[2])
    y2 = int(data[3])
    
    result = min_quadcopter_path(x1, y1, x2, y2)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
